newsitem.title: USA: Brunswick to buy Igloo for $154 million.
newsitem.headline: Brunswick to buy Igloo for $154 million.

text.p: Recreation equipment maker Brunswick Corp. said Monday it has signed a definitive agreement to acquire Igloo Holdings Inc. for about $154 million in cash.
Houston-based Igloo is a privately held company which makes ice chests, beverage coolers and thermoelectric cooler/warmer products. It has annual sales of about $150 million.
Igloo will become part of the Brunswick Outdoor Recreation Group, based in Tulsa, Oklahoma.
The deal is expected to close in early 1997.
Lake Forest, Ill.-based Brunswick is the world's largest manufacturer of marine engines and pleasure boats.
Its stock rose 12.5 cents to $25 on the New York Stock Exchange at mid-morning.
